metadata.name: async-boundary-accessible-description
metadata.description: Verify the default AsyncBoundary description remains linked and nonempty for assistive technology without occupying visible layout.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-async-boundary]'); const d=document.getElementById(b.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); const r=d.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(d); if (!d.textContent.trim() || d.getAttribute('aria-hidden')==='true' || s.display==='none' || s.visibility==='hidden') throw new Error('Accessible description was removed'); if (r.width>1 || r.height>1 || s.position!=='absolute') throw new Error('Accessible description occupies visible layout: '+JSON.stringify({width:r.width,height:r.height,position:s.position})); return {description:d.textContent,width:r.width,height:r.height}; })()
